output.review_summary: Confirmed CONTRADICTED. Scenario applicability holds: the borrower supplied all four fields (views.py:0031 form; store.py:0077-0078 insert) and the case is a current contract. Machine-readable delivery is satisfied (app.py:0107-0109 application/json attachment, owner-gated at 0105), inferred decisions are excluded (portable() key tuple contains no stage/confirmed/decision), and the transfer targets the selected local receiver (store.py:0202). The decisive defect is store.py:0116: portable() returns only email, amount, income, omitting 'term' even though it is persisted (store.py:0037) and available on the case row. Both the borrower download (app.py:0106) and the direct transfer (store.py:0203) reuse this incomplete payload, so the four-field completeness requirement fails on both required targets. No in-scope counterexample rescues the draft; the draft's own limits (no runtime verification, stage is a scenario fact) are correctly stated and do not undermine the static defect.
